claim: Origin mTLS can be configured on a per-distribution or per-origin basis, using client certificates from AWS Certificate Manager Private Certificate Authority or from third-party private certificate authorities that you import through AWS Certificate Manager.

evidence.quote: CloudFront offers granular control, allowing you to configure origin mTLS on a per- distribution or per-origin basis, ensuring only verified CloudFront distributions can access your backend infrastructure.

You can configure origin mTLS using client certificates from AWS Certificate Manager Private Certificate Authority or third-party private certificate authorities, which you import through AWS Certificate Manager.
